               ORDER SETTING DEADLINES FOR RESPONSES AND REPLIES

          THIS MATTER comes before the New Mexico Public Regulation Commission

(“Commission”) upon El Paso Electric Company’s (“EPE”) Notice Under Rule 17.9.530.11(A)

and Verified Petition for Variance (“Petition”). With this order the Commission establishes

deadlines for permitted responses and replies, in order to facilitate the Commission’s ruling upon

this matter at its open meeting on December 18, 2025.

                                          DISCUSSION

          1.     On December 4, 2025, EPE filed its Petition requesting a variance of Schedule Q-

6 under Rule 530.13(Q)(6) and Rule 530.14(Q)(6) for EPE’s forthcoming Minimum Data

Requirements Filing Package in support of its February 2026 application for revision of retail rates.

Specifically, EPE requests a variance to file its audit report prepared under 18 C.FR. Part 41 for

calendar year 2024 when it becomes available around mid-April 2026. 1

          2.     EPE informed the Commission that “Staff does not oppose this Petition for

Variance with the understanding that the audited numbers do not change the February filing.” 2

          3.     Rule 17.9.530.11(B) NMAC establishes that upon receiving notice of a utility’s

inability to comply with any data filing request contained in Appendix A to Rule 17.9.530 NMAC,

the Commission shall within fifteen days notify the applicant in writing of its decision concerning




1 Petition (December 4, 2025) at 1.
2 Id. at 6.
 the applicant utility’s notice of its inability to comply with the Commission’s Data Filing

Requirements.

        IT IS THEREFORE ORDERED:

        A.      Any responses to EPE’s Petition shall be filed by noon, December 12, 2025.

        B.      Any replies shall be filed by noon, December 16, 2025.

        C.      This Order is effective when signed.

        D.      The Commission shall serve a copy of this Order upon all persons listed on the

attached Certificate of Service via e-mail if their e-mail addresses are known, and otherwise, via

regular mail.

        E.      In computing time in accordance with statute, regulation, or Commission order, the

computation shall begin on the date that this Order is filed with the Chief Clerk of the

Commission’s Records Management Bureau or the Chief Clerk’s designee.

        SIGNED under the Seal of the Commission at Santa Fe, New Mexico, this 8th day of

December, 2025.

                          NEW MEXICO PUBLIC REGULATION COMMISSION

                          /s/ Greg Nibert, electronically signed
                          GREG NIBERT, COMMISSIONER
